concepts.title: HTML Basics and Structure
concepts.description: Learn HTML document structure and basic elements

teachingContent.beginner:
**HTML** (HyperText Markup Language) is the structure of web pages. **Basic HTML Document:** ```html My First Page

Hello World!

This is my first webpage.

``` **Key Parts:** - ``: Tells browser it's HTML5 - ``: Root element - ``: Metadata (not visible) - ``: Visible content
teachingContent.intermediate:
HTML document structure and metadata:

**Head Elements:**
```html
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="description" content="My website">
    <meta name="keywords" content="HTML, CSS, JavaScript">
    <meta name="author" content="John Doe">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
    <script src="script.js"></script>
</head>
```

**Document Outline:**
- Use proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
- One h1 per page
- Logical content structure
teachingContent.advanced:
Advanced HTML features:

**Meta Tags for SEO:**
```html
<meta property="og:title" content="Page Title">
<meta property="og:description" content="Description">
<meta property="og:image" content="image.jpg">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary">
```

**Preloading Resources:**
```html
<link rel="preload" href="font.woff2" as="font">
<link rel="prefetch" href="next-page.html">
```

concepts.title: Forms and Input
concepts.description: Learn to create forms and handle user input

teachingContent.beginner:
**Forms** collect user input.

**Basic Form:**
```html
<form action="/submit" method="POST">
    <label for="name">Name:</label>
    <input type="text" id="name" name="name">
    
    <label for="email">Email:</label>
    <input type="email" id="email" name="email">
    
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
```

**Input Types:**
```html
<input type="text">      <!-- Text -->
<input type="email">     <!-- Email -->
<input type="password">  <!-- Password -->
<input type="number">    <!-- Number -->
<input type="date">      <!-- Date picker -->
<input type="checkbox">  <!-- Checkbox -->
<input type="radio">     <!-- Radio button -->
```
teachingContent.intermediate:
Advanced form elements:

**Textarea and Select:**
```html
<textarea name="message" rows="4" cols="50">
    Default text
</textarea>

<select name="country">
    <option value="us">United States</option>
    <option value="uk">United Kingdom</option>
</select>
```

**Form Validation:**
```html
<input type="email" required>
<input type="text" minlength="3" maxlength="20">
<input type="number" min="1" max="100">
<input type="text" pattern="[A-Za-z]{3}">
```
teachingContent.advanced:
Advanced form features:

**Fieldset and Legend:**
```html
<fieldset>
    <legend>Personal Information</legend>
    <input type="text" name="name">
    <input type="email" name="email">
</fieldset>
```

**Datalist:**
```html
<input list="browsers" name="browser">
<datalist id="browsers">
    <option value="Chrome">
    <option value="Firefox">
    <option value="Safari">
</datalist>
```
